# OutdoorPainter

> > OutdoorPainter is the premier resource for plein air and outdoor painting techniques, artist interviews, and painting demonstrations across oil, watercolor, acrylic, and pastel mediums.

Published by PleinAir Magazine and hosted by Eric Rhoads, OutdoorPainter features step-by-step painting tutorials, the PleinAir Podcast series with artist interviews, coverage of events like the Plein Air Convention & Expo, and practical advice on landscape painting techniques and art marketing.

## Key Topics

- Plein air painting
- Landscape painting
- Oil painting techniques
- Watercolor techniques
- PleinAir Podcast
- Painting demonstrations
- Artist interviews
- Plein Air Convention & Expo
- Color theory and values
- Art marketing
- Acadia National Park painting locations
- Pastel painting
- Acrylic painting
- Art competitions and PleinAir Salon
- Outdoor painting locations

## Painting Techniques & Demonstrations

- [5 Fixes for 5 Common Painting Mistakes](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/5-fixes-for-5-common-painting-landscapes-mistakes): John Pototschnik's guide to fixing common landscape painting mistakes
- [Dull Scene? Boost the Color! (free demo)](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/dull-scene-boost-color-free-landscape-painting-demonstration): Jed Dorsey's step-by-step plein air landscape painting demo on color harmony
- [Watercolor Technique: How To Develop Your Brushwork](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/watercolor-technique-how-to-develop-your-brushwork): Dan Marshall tutorial on developing watercolor brushwork techniques
- [Plein Air Watercolor: From Sketch to Finish](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/from-plein-air-watercolor-sketches-to-large-scale-painting): Marjorie Glick's watercolor demo from sketch to finish at Acadia

## PleinAir Podcast: Artist Interviews

- [Plein Air Podcast 240: Rich Gallego on Close Calls and More](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/plein-air-podcast-240-rich-gallego-on-close-calls-and-more): Episode 240: Eric Rhoads interviews California artist Rich Gallego
- [Plein Air Podcast 230: CW Mundy (Part 1) on Impressionism + Pop Art, and more](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/plein-air-podcast-230-cw-mundy-part-1-on-impressionism-pop-art-and-more): Episode 230: CW Mundy discusses impressionism and pop art with Eric Rhoads
- [PleinAir Podcast 194: Beverly Ford Evans on Understanding Values and More](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/pleinair-podcast-194-beverly-ford-evans-on-understanding-values-and-more): Episode 194: Beverly Ford Evans on wildlife painting and values
- [PleinAir Podcast 173: Lori Putnam on Painting Loosely and More](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/pleinair-podcast-173-lori-putnam-on-painting-loosely-and-more): Episode 173: Lori Putnam on loose painting and impressionist techniques
- [PleinAir Podcast 182: PleinAir Live Women's Panel on the Art-Life Balance](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/pleinair-podcast-182-pleinair-live-womens-panel-on-the-art-life-balance): Women's panel with McGraw, Hunt, and Hudson on art-life balance

## Artist Spotlights & Featured Work

- [Painting Anywhere I Can Be Present](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/painting-anywhere-i-can-be-present): Artist spotlight featuring Cindy Harris on favorite plein air locations
- [Joe Gyurcsak: How Still Waters Brought a Calm to the Crisis](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/painting-outdoors-joe-gyurcsak-still-waters): Joe Gyurcsak on painting Still Waters during COVID-19 crisis
- [My Favorite Place to Paint: Kim Carlton](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/my-favorite-place-to-paint-kim-carlton): Kim Carlton on painting Galveston Bay and Texas coastal landscapes
- [Featured Artwork: Linda Mutti](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/featured-artwork-linda-mutti): Linda Mutti's pastel painting from Eastern Sierras, Bishop, California
- [Going to Extremes: Plein Air Painting in a Rail Yard](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/going-to-extremes-plein-air-painting-in-a-rail-yard): Thom Rozendaal paints abandoned train car in Pisa rail yard

## Competitions & Awards

- ["A Mind of Winter" Wins](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/pleinair-salon-mind-of-winter-wins): PleinAir Salon March 2023 winners announced by Timothy Standring
- [Winning a $20,000 Fellowship](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/winning-a-20000-fellowship): Tom Nachreiner wins OPA's Dorothy Driehaus Mellin Fellowship

## Events & Plein Air Gatherings

- [Unforgettable Moments - And It's Only Day 1](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/unforgettable-moments-and-its-only-day-1): PACE 10th Anniversary opening day coverage in Denver, Colorado
- [Landscapes and Lobsters](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/landscapes-and-lobsters): Fall Color Week painting retreat at Acadia National Park, Maine
- [Art, Music, Ocean Views](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/art-music-ocean-views): LPAPA plein air event at Heisler Park with music and ocean views
- [All-Star Group Gets Pastel Show in Spain](https://www.outdoorpainter.com/all-star-group-gets-pastel-show-in-spain): American pastel artists featured in Spain museum exhibition
